title: Output guardrails + governance cards + C2PA provenance (BI-0219)

rcca.root_cause: AI products lacked output-level safety + governance: no guardrails on LLM/media output, no model/data cards, no generated-media provenance, no NIST/EU checkpointing.
rcca.corrective: core/guardrails.py (config/guardrail-policy.json): check/enforce allow|flag|block|redact fail-closed; model/data cards; c2pa_manifest; governance checkpoints; Guardrail-Report; BOM + stage-9 integration; API.
rcca.preventive: Policy versioned+validated (malformed => block); high-severity never silently allows; single writer for Guardrail-Report; reuses redaction + catalogs.
rcca.fixed_where: core/guardrails.py; core/bom.py; core/orchestrator/stage_runner.py; config/guardrail-policy.json; dashboard/api/app.py; docs/GUARDRAILS-DESIGN.md; commit 41e2307
